term: h/i/j/k exact-path convergence and valuation correspondence
definition: Convergent F h i j k means that any exact h-path from w to a and exact j-path from w to b admit a c reached from a by an exact i-path and from b by an exact k-path. convergenceFormula is the one-atom Unit-language instance diamond^h box^i p → box^j diamond^k p. Valid quantifies over every atomic valuation and every world; a single valuation is insufficient for its converse. Generic soundness separately permits any modal formula over any supplied atom type.
note: Mathematical modal correspondence role, not analytic limit convergence, a global common endpoint, finite cardinality, linearity, Hilbert derivability/completeness or a metaphysical accessibility claim. The natural-number indices may be zero, retaining identity paths.
